ImpactStatement: Active Directory replication is failing across the network, causing three out of ten domain controllers to experience issues. One domain controller has lost the NETLOGON share, while the other two have incomplete SYSVOL policy files, affecting proper group policy application and authentication.
TroubleshootingPerformedByCustomer: Customer attempted a non-authoritative restore on affected domain controllers, but replication errors persisted.
TroubleshootingStepsPerformedByACES: ACES reviewed DFSR states, attempted non-authoritative restore, scheduled meetings to reassess domain controller configuration and policy application.
IsNeoEnabled: Not specified - Need to check Setup logs
RootCause: Incorrect Active Directory site topology configuration led to replication failures and inconsistent SYSVOL content across domain controllers.
MitigationSteps: Review and correct site topology, verify DFSR configuration, perform non-authoritative restore, and ensure proper policy files and NETLOGON share on all domain controllers.
